bounds.family: ciphers with fewer than 26 output symbols or an even-length rule

verdicts.Playfair: excluded: emits at most 25 letters; K4 has 26; needs an even length; K4 has 97
verdicts.two-square: excluded: emits at most 25 letters; K4 has 26; needs an even length; K4 has 97
verdicts.four-square: excluded: emits at most 25 letters; K4 has 26; needs an even length; K4 has 97
verdicts.bifid 5x5: excluded: emits at most 25 letters; K4 has 26
verdicts.ADFGX: excluded: emits at most 5 letters; K4 has 26; needs an even length; K4 has 97
verdicts.ADFGVX: excluded: emits at most 6 letters; K4 has 26; needs an even length; K4 has 97
verdicts.Weltzeituhr 24-letter ring: excluded: emits at most 24 letters; K4 has 26
verdicts.Polybius 5x5 to letters: excluded: emits at most 25 letters; K4 has 26

escape_routes: a null letter appended to make the length even (then the 25-letter rule still applies)
a 6x6 square with digits written out as words

notes: K4 uses all 26 letters and has 97 letters; every listed system is excluded: Playfair; two-square; four-square; bifid 5x5; ADFGX; ADFGVX; Weltzeituhr 24-letter ring; Polybius 5x5 to letters.
